caption: Record Integrity Signature Value Dictionary
description: Attributes added by the integrity extension.

signature_value.caption: Signature Value
signature_value.description: The digital signature bytes, Base64-encoded. For enveloped schemes identified by serialization_id (JWS, COSE, DSSE), this carries the complete detached envelope; for Flat or JCS schemes it carries the raw signature over the signed byte sequence.
